7:58.text: The vegetation of a good land comes forth
by the Permission of its Lord; and that which is bad, brings forth nothing but
with difficulty. Thus do We explain variously the Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
for a people who give thanks.

7:59.text: to his people and he said: "O my people! Worship Allâh! You have no other Ilâh
(Lâ ilâha illallâh: none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh)
. Certainly, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day!"

7:60.text: The leaders of his people said: "Verily, we see you in plain error."

7:61.text: said: "O my people! There is no error in me, but I am a Messenger from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn

7:62.text: "I convey unto you the Messages of my Lord and give sincere advice to you. And I know from Allâh what you know not.

7:63.text: "Do you wonder that there has come to you a Reminder from your Lord through a man from amongst you, that he may warn you, so that you may fear Allâh and that you may receive

7:64.text: But they belied him, so We saved him and those along with him in the ship, and We drowned those who belied Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
. They were indeed a blind people.
